title: Edgar Mitchell's last filmed interview: a secret group withholding UFO information

tellings.quote: we we got down to brass tacks, and yes, that's that's exactly what he said. He told me who he talked with.

plain: In his last filmed interview, given at his home around 2015 to 2016, the Apollo astronaut Edgar Mitchell said that a secret group was keeping UFO information from the public. The filmmaker Jeremy Corbell, who did the interview, says that is exactly what Mitchell told him, and that Mitchell also named the people he had talked with. Coming from a man who walked on the moon, it would mean the secret was confirmed by someone on the inside.
